kl.procedure: Evaluate frozen KL-CMAPPO actors on a modest tau grid. For each target, select the measured tau whose mean TX reduction is closest to the target. Report that tau's measured MAE/recall/AoI (mean±sample SD over seeds). Do not interpolate MAE or recall.

bc.procedure: Linear interpolation of MAE/recall vs TX reduction from frozen scientific_validation CSVs (ddof=0 in the source file). Checkpoints were not present for a direct sweep.

mixed_kl_direct_bc_interpolated.reason: KL matched-budget MAE/recall are directly measured; BC values are linearly interpolated from a legacy summary. Do not treat them as a matched-budget bake-off.

threshold_selection: validation only; freeze tau; evaluate that tau (no test-set tau search)
